baslik: Ziggy the Fox Learns to Wait for His Turn
ders: Taking turns lets everyone have fun
aciklama: There is only one leaf boat by the pond, and Ziggy wants it right now. Luna shows him a fun way to wait. A story about taking turns.

satirlar.metin: By the pond, there was one little leaf boat for everyone.
Me first! Me first! I want to sail right now!
But Ziggy, Pip has been waiting since this morning.
It's okay to want a turn. We can take turns, one by one.
Waiting is so hard! My paws can't stay still!
Hoo! While you wait, try counting slowly to ten with me.
One, two, three... Ziggy counted, and the waiting felt shorter.
Your turn, Ziggy! Sail across the pond and wave to us!
Wheee! Waiting made my turn feel extra special!
When we take turns, everyone gets to have fun.
